Portronics Breeze 7 Portable Speaker (Black) – 15W Bluetooth Power with Deep Bass

The Portronics Breeze 7 Portable Speaker is designed for music lovers who want powerful sound in a compact, travel-ready build. With a strong 15W output, advanced Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity, and up to 6 hours playtime, this speaker delivers clear audio, punchy bass, and seamless pairing for indoor and outdoor use. Whether you are hosting a house party, relaxing at home, or heading out for a trip, the Breeze 7 ensures your playlist stays loud and immersive.

Built with convenience in mind, the speaker features a smooth rotational volume control for precise adjustments and fast access to your preferred sound level. The modern black finish complements any setup, while the Type-C charging port offers quick and reliable power top-ups. Lightweight yet durable, it is an ideal choice for anyone searching for a portable Bluetooth speaker with bass at a great value.

Key Features of Portronics Breeze 7 Portable Speaker

  • High performance 15W sound output for loud, room-filling audio
  • Latest Bluetooth 5.4 wireless connectivity for stable, fast pairing
  • Enjoy up to 6 hours of continuous playtime on a single charge
  • Modern rotational volume controller for smooth operation
  • Convenient USB Type-C charging support
  • Sleek and stylish black portable design
  • Ideal for travel, parties, home entertainment, and office use

Powerful 15W Audio Performance

Experience dynamic sound with enhanced clarity thanks to the 15W acoustic setup. From vocals to bass-heavy tracks, the audio remains balanced even at higher volumes. If you are looking for a loud portable Bluetooth speaker that performs beyond its size, the Breeze 7 is engineered to impress.

Seamless Bluetooth 5.4 Connectivity

The integrated Bluetooth 5.4 technology ensures quicker pairing, lower latency, and better energy efficiency. Connect your smartphone, tablet, or laptop effortlessly and stream music, podcasts, or calls without interruptions. It is perfect for users searching for a wireless for mobile with reliable range.

Long-Lasting Battery Backup

With up to six hours of playback, the Breeze 7 keeps your music alive through gatherings, workouts, or movie sessions. Recharge quickly via the modern Type-C interface and get back to your entertainment in less time.

Smart Control & Portable Style

The intuitive rotary knob makes volume adjustments easy and precise, adding a premium feel to everyday use. Its compact body fits neatly into bags, making it a dependable travel Bluetooth for vacations and outdoor fun.

Why Choose ?

Combining portability, strong sound, and user-friendly controls, this offers excellent value for money. It suits students, professionals, and families who want dependable wireless audio with modern charging and design.
